stem: A primary tooth in a child has been lost well ahead of its normal exfoliation time. Which approach is most consistent with current guidance?

options.text: Assume arch length is unaffected, because losing a primary tooth early does not change the arch.
Consider space maintenance, because premature loss can reduce arch length.
Avoid space maintenance in every case of premature primary tooth loss.
Consider space maintenance only after a permanent tooth has been lost.
